{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
At least one thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Morodin/Legends|Morodin]] utilized '''organic space vessels''' to travel the stars. They were used to transport food from the Morodin colony on [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]] to the [[Morodin homeworld]]. The ships were grown, and at some point an ecological disaster left the Morodins unable to grow these ships, effectively severing contact between Morodin colonies.
